# Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**Global shell.** A fixed vertical week-timeline runs down the left sidebar: five nodes, Mon–Fri, connected by a thin tide-line. The current day glows coral; ticks beside each node pulse as teammates complete tasks in a live demo feed. On mobile it collapses to a slim horizontal strip under the header.

**1. Hero.** Full-height, deep tidepool teal (#0E3B3B) background. Headline in a warm serif (Fraunces), one long conversational sentence: *"Pull your whole team into one calm view of the week ahead, where every task has an owner, every day has a shape, and Friday never arrives as a surprise."* A hand-drawn coral arrow curls from the headline's last words to the hero image: a screenshot of the shared week board, tilted 2°, with a sticky-note annotation reading "this is Tuesday, handled." Sub-line plus a single coral CTA: "Plan your first week."

**2. The ritual.** Three horizontal cards — Drop it in, Balance the load, Close the week — each visually tethered to a sidebar node with a dotted connector line, so scrolling past them walks the workweek.

**3. Feature zoom-ins.** Three tight screenshots with hand-drawn coral circles around one detail each: drag-to-reassign, the "overloaded?" nudge, Friday recap digest. No feature grid; let the annotations do the talking.

**4. Pull quote.** Set in monospace (JetBrains Mono), oversized, on a cream band: *"We stopped having the Monday meeting. The week just… starts."* — attributed to a 6-person studio lead.

**5. Before/after.** Split panel: a chaotic tangled to-do list vs. the same week in Tidepool. Palette does the work — noisy red scribbles left, calm teal grid right.

**6. Closing CTA + footer.** Repeat headline rhythm shortened: "Your week, together." Email capture, small print, timeline node for "Today" repeated as a signature mark.
final:
# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**Global shell.** Fixed left rail: five Mon–Fri nodes on a gently undulating SVG tide-line (slow, lapping motion). Nodes double as scroll-spy nav — clicking Thursday jumps to the section tethered to it. Beneath the rail, a slim live strip shows teammates' avatars drifting to the day they're currently planning, making "together" visible before a single word is read. On mobile, the rail becomes a thin tide-line progress bar pinned to the top edge.

**1. Hero.** Deep teal (#0E3B3B), headline in Fraunces with three deliberate beats mirroring the product's promises: *"Pull your whole team into one calm view of the week, where tasks land with the right person, Tidepool learns the shape of your Tuesdays, and Friday never arrives as a surprise."* Hand-drawn coral arrow (Caveat typeface) curls from "Tidepool learns" to the tilted screenshot, where a circled detail reads *"noticed: release planning usually lives here."* Coral CTA (#FF6B57): "Plan your first week." Ghost secondary: "Watch a week in 90 seconds."

**2. The ritual.** Three cards, dotted connectors tethering each to a rail node: **Drop it in** — "any thought, any time, from anyone." **Balance it** — "the overloaded day gets flagged before it happens." **Close it** — "Friday's recap writes itself."

**3. Tidepool notices.** The memory story, made visual: one screenshot, three hand-drawn coral circles — recurring tasks surfacing themselves, a chronic-overload nudge, the learned-rhythm suggestion. Replaces a generic feature grid.

**4. Pull quote.** Monospace (JetBrains Mono), oversized, cream band (#F7F3E8): *"We cancelled the Monday meeting. The week just… starts."* — 6-person studio lead.

**5. Before/after.** Split panel: tangled red-scribble list vs. calm teal grid. Caption: "Same team. Same week."

**6. Proof strip.** "Trusted by 2,400 small teams" with a hand-drawn underline.

**7. Closing CTA + footer.** "Your week, together." Email capture; the Today node reappears as the signature mark.
